transcript: That day, a special exhibition was being held at the museum Valuable paintings brought from Europe were being exhibited in Japan for the first time At the entrance I bought a ticket and walked along the route In the first room, portraits from the 15th century were on display The faces of kings and nobles painted with a primitive yet powerful brush stroke The next room held impressionist paintings Monet, Renoir, Degas Attempts to capture the light appeared Each with the personality of its artist I stopped before one painting Engaged at it for a long time Other visitors passed by Whispering something The painting awakened, remained with me A female guide was explaining the historical background of the paintings to newly arrived students They were eagerly taking notes When I left the museum I carried a profound satisfaction in my heart Heart, across time and place This quietly brings relief to the heart of the viewer It is not a luxury, but one of the forms of nourishment That human beings need

segments.text: That day, a special exhibition was being held at the museum
Valuable paintings brought from Europe were being exhibited in Japan for the first time
At the entrance I bought a ticket and walked along the route
In the first room, portraits from the 15th century were on display
The faces of kings and nobles painted with a primitive yet powerful brush stroke
The next room held impressionist paintings
Monet, Renoir, Degas
Attempts to capture the light appeared
Each with the personality of its artist
I stopped before one painting
Engaged at it for a long time
Other visitors passed by
Whispering something
The painting awakened, remained with me
A female guide was explaining the historical background of the paintings to newly arrived students
They were eagerly taking notes
When I left the museum
I carried a profound satisfaction in my heart
Heart, across time and place
This quietly brings relief to the heart of the viewer
It is not a luxury, but one of the forms of nourishment
That human beings need
